title: tofieldia glutinosa subsp. typica
intro: Tofieldia glutinosa subsp. typica, commonly known as Yellow Bog Orchid or Bog Orchid, is a plant species belonging to the family Tofieldiaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Tofieldia glutinosa subsp. typica include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral effects.
